LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.Intro: Where each garment class stops on the body. 0 is the hem, 1 is the top of the head. TailorMade's own values are 0.58, 0.20 and 0.45. Lower the first if trousers ride above the navel on a body drawn without legs.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.Scope: Global settings, shared by every save. Changes apply when this window closes.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.PantsTopTi: The height of the waistband as a fraction of the body's height: 0 is the hem; 1 is the top of the head. TailorMade's value is 0.58.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.BootsTopTi: How far up the body footwear is drawn, as a fraction of the body's height. TailorMade's value is 0.20.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.ChestBotto: Where the lower edge of a chest piece lands, as a fraction of the body's height. TailorMade's value is 0.45.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.Experiment: Enable experimental WDI APP shirt and pants patterns

Experimental: Apparel Paper Pattern fits the vanilla T-shirt and pants to the ten WDI body silhouettes through separate upper and lower masks. It is read when the game starts. Enable it only to review the result; Middle, Shell, dresses, and modded apparel are not covered yet.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.FitTops: Fit tops to the body's silhouette
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.FitTopsTip: A shirt drawn for another body sticks out of the silhouette of a WDI body at the shoulders and the collar. When enabled, every garment worn on the skin that covers the torso but not the legs, whatever mod it comes from, is cut along the outline of the body, keeping its colours and its hem. Garments TailorMade fits itself are left alone. It applies to garments drawn after the change; restart the game to refresh the ones already shown.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.KeepJacket: Extend jackets down to the trousers

A vanilla jacket is drawn for a body with legs and ends at the waist. On a legless body, this leaves the trousers visible beneath it. When enabled, this option stretches shell-layer garments - jackets, coats, and parkas - down from below the navel to the hem of the trousers, and TailorMade no longer fits them into the chest band. On-skin shirts are unaffected. Requires AB's Visible Pants; read at startup.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.KeepDresse: Leave dresses drawn for the body as they are

A dress, robe or long coat that its own mod drew for the body, for instance a texture made for the Fat body, is neither resized nor clipped by TailorMade, which would trim its skirt and the plates at its hips. Turn this off to let TailorMade fit them anyway. This setting is read when the game starts.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.ShortenShi: TailorMade only bands a torso garment whose art already starts 40% of the way up, which leaves a vanilla shirt, drawn over the whole body, full length and hiding the trousers entirely. This removes that requirement for on-skin garments, and the chest slider above then decides where they stop. Coats, parkas and robes are worn on the shell layer and still drape to the ankles. The shirt is compressed into the band, not cut off at it, so collars and buttons are squeezed along with it.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.UseGeneral: AB's Visible Pants draws its trousers as a plain shell. General Textures Collection includes a retexture of the same garment with a waistband, belt loops and a fly, but only loads it when XeoNovaDan's Visible Pants is active. With AB active instead, this reads those textures from General's installed folder. Nothing is copied. It needs General Textures Collection to be installed.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.DetailShel: Draw details on plain trouser shells

When no such retexture is available - for a child or a body type that General does not cover - this option draws a waistband, fly, and seams onto AB's plain shell, and separates the legs at the bottom.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.TrouserDro: Moves the trouser art down the body, as a fraction of its height. 0 leaves it where it was drawn. It only applies to the trousers this mod supplies, meaning General Textures Collection's art and the details drawn onto AB's shells.
The same, for a child. It is a separate value because a child is drawn smaller, so the same fraction of the picture is fewer pixels on screen.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.ArtNeedsRe: These four trouser settings take effect when the game starts, not when this window closes. When either of the first two options is enabled, TailorMade does not fit the trousers supplied by this mod into a band, so the pants slider above does not apply to them. With both options disabled, it does.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.PatchDirec: Patched at the source: changes show as soon as this window closes.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.PatchFallb: Running on the fallback patch: quit and restart the game for changes to appear, because TailorMade's cached textures were keyed to the old value.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.NoTailorMa: TailorMade is not loaded, so its three bands and resizing settings are unavailable. The trousers and body-specific shirts below still work.
